conviction_note: Sum of five signed findings (-4.0, -3.5, -2.5, -1.5, +2.0) on a name with no option chain, 116% realised vol and a +76% six-session melt-up (including roughly +18% intraday on print day itself) driven entirely by three documents that contain no new economics: a fourth recycled US$10m buyback authorisation whose 2024 predecessor executed ~1%, Form 4s that are automated 10b5-1 fills, and a boilerplate joint-filing-agreement 13D/A; meanwhile the Q1 balance sheet shows 62% of the celebrated 359% revenue growth came from draining a deferred-revenue balance built by Q4 2025 pre-sales.

findings.finding: Deferred revenue and advances from customers fell from RMB165.9m at 31-Dec-2025 to RMB104.5m at 31-Mar-2026, so RMB61.4m of the RMB99.5m of Q1 revenue that produced the headline '+359% YoY' was a drawdown of Q4 2025 pre-sale orders: implied new billings were only about RMB38m, less than the RMB43.2m spent on sales and marketing in the same quarter, and cash plus restricted cash plus term deposits fell RMB54.6m (RMB407.0m to RMB352.4m) against a reported net loss of just RMB19.4m.
findings.why_not_priced: The wire copy on this quarter is 'AI learning app lifts 17EdTech revenue 359%, net loss down 37.4%' — headline growth and headline loss. The deferred-revenue line sits in the condensed balance sheet at the back of the same release and nobody has subtracted it: no sell-side analyst publishes an estimate on YQ, stockanalysis.com's news feed carries only the three headline items, and the release contains no cash-flow statement so the RMB54.6m cash decline versus a RMB19.4m loss has to be computed by differencing two balance sheets. If this were priced, the stock would not have closed the entire discount to book — shareholders' equity of RMB269.1m (US$39.0m) at 31-Mar-2026 against a US$37.5m market cap at $3.45 puts YQ at roughly 1.0x a book value that is falling about RMB18m a quarter, i.e. the deep-value cushion that justified the whole run has already gone. With only RMB104.5m of deferred balance left, the Q2 release's own deferred-revenue and cash lines are where this becomes visible for a second consecutive quarter.
findings.independence: Chinese trade coverage independently describes the Q4 2025 launch as a membership product sold on pre-orders ('achieved strong pre-sale orders'), which is the mechanism: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000119312526122709/yq-ex99_1.htm (2026-03-25). Separately, Tencent News coverage of 2026-07-12 attributes the growth to a To-B/To-G 'smart paper-pen + AI' school solution covering 2,000+ schools rather than to the consumer app the English release credits, which is a second, unrelated reason to doubt the revenue narrative: https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20260712A066GD00. Note the RMB61.4m, RMB38m and RMB54.6m figures all come from the single Q1 6-K exhibit and are one finding, not three.
findings.shared_source_note: The valuation-cushion arithmetic (equity RMB269.1m vs US$37.5m cap) comes from this same Q1 6-K exhibit and is deliberately kept inside this finding rather than filed separately.

findings.finding: The US$10 million buyback authorisation announced 2026-09-03 that triggered the +21.5% jump is at least the fourth identical US$10 million 12-month authorisation the company has issued (November 2021, September 2024, September 2025, September 2026), and the FY2024 20-F discloses that only approximately US$0.1 million had actually been repurchased under the September 2024 programme as of 31-Dec-2024 — about 1% of the authorisation.
findings.why_not_priced: Volume on the announcement day was 2,789,500 ADSs against a 20-day pre-event median of 4,600 — a 600x spike. That is a buyer base that arrived on the headline, not one that pulled the 2024 20-F. If the recycling were priced, the third and fourth iterations of an identical press release would have produced no move at all, and the aggregator write-ups would say 'renews' rather than 'Approves $10M Share Buyback' and 'announces NEW share repurchase program'. The company also has RMB104.5m of deferred revenue and a RMB54.6m quarterly cash decline standing in front of the RMB71m the authorisation would cost, which is a capacity constraint the 2024 execution rate already demonstrated.
findings.independence: The prior identical authorisations are documented in three separate places: the 2021 release at https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2021/11/02/2325327/0/en/17-Education-Technology-Group-Inc-Announces-US-10-Million-Share-Repurchase-Program-and-Plan-to-Implement-ADS-Ratio-Change.html (URL path confirms 2021, not 2026), the FY2024 20-F which contains the phrase 'repurchased approximately US$0.1 million' (single hit for this CIK on EDGAR full-text search) at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000095017025058824/yq-20241231.htm, and the FY2025 20-F whose inline-XBRL tags include 'ShareRepurchaseProgramInSeptemberTwoThousandAndTwentyFive' at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000119312526191472/yq-20251231.htm.

findings.finding: The CEO's near-daily Form 4 open-market ADS purchases through August and early September — reported by aggregators as conviction buying — are executions of a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan entered into on 2026-03-31 with Tiger Brokers (NZ) Limited covering 30-Jun-2026 to 31-Mar-2028, a fact disclosed for the first time in Item 6 of a Schedule 13D/A filed on the morning of the print itself.
findings.why_not_priced: The plan was signed on 31-Mar-2026, before Q2 even began, so the purchases carry zero information about the quarter being reported — yet the coverage that exists reads the opposite way: 'Chang Liu Purchases 10,000 Shares of 17 Education & Technology Group' framed as insider conviction, on a site that even gets the exchange wrong (NYSE:YQ; YQ is Nasdaq). The 13D/A was filed hours before the release, has no wire pickup, and its only exhibit is a boilerplate joint filing agreement with no economics in it — so if the market had read it, today's roughly +18% would not be happening on a day whose sole company document adds nothing. The purchases are also tiny in dollars: 10,000 ADSs at $2.3788 is $23,800, and the transactions coded 'L' are Rule 16a-6 small acquisitions of 2 to 1,857 ADSs.
findings.independence: The Form 4s themselves, filed by a different route, show the mechanical daily cadence and the trivial size: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001821468/000119312526341197/ownership.xml (filed 2026-08-10, transactions 3-6 Aug at $2.11-$2.16) and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000119312526382783/ownership.xml (filed 2026-09-04, 10,000 ADS at $2.3788). The misreading in third-party coverage is at https://www.thecerbatgem.com/2026/09/04/chang-liu-purchases-10000-shares-of-17-education-technology-group-nyseyq-stock.html. Shares its source document with the +2.0 structural-bid finding below.
findings.shared_source_note: Same 13D/A as the final finding; the two are opposite-signed readings of one document and should be collapsed to their net.

findings.finding: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu was dismissed as auditor effective 2026-05-27 — four weeks after signing the FY2025 20-F and three weeks before the Q1 revenue inflection was reported — and replaced by Marcum Asia CPAs LLP, a firm the PCAOB censured and fined US$100,000 on 2025-09-23.
findings.why_not_priced: The 6-K disclosing the change moved the stock -3.99% on 4,600-share median volume — that is not a market clearing an information event, that is a filing nobody read. There is no analyst coverage to write it up, the change was reported as a dismissal with no disagreements and no reportable events so it generated no wire story, and it has never been connected in print to the fact that the revenue line inflected 359% in the very quarter that straddles the change. If it were priced, a Big-Four-to-second-tier downgrade at a China ADR carrying a large deferred-revenue balance would show as a persistent governance discount rather than a 1.0x book multiple after a 76% run. Q2 is the first release published under the new engagement.
findings.independence: PCAOB's own sanction release, an entirely separate source: https://pcaobus.org/news-events/news-releases/news-release-detail/pcaob-sanctions-u.s.-audit-firm-for-violations-related-to-communications-between-predecessor-and-successor-auditors (2025-09-23). A same-quarter CFO change points the same way — Sishi Zhou was confirmed as CFO on 2026-03-24 after nine months as Acting CFO: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000119312526120598/yq-ex99_1.htm.

findings.finding: There is a real structural bid under the stock that cuts against the fade: the CEO's 10b5-1 plan runs to 31-Mar-2028 and the US$10m authorisation is live, against a non-Liu share base of only about 6.4m ADS-equivalent (542.2m shares outstanding less Andy Chang Liu's 223.9m / 41.30%) and a pre-spike median volume of 4,600 ADSs a day.
findings.why_not_priced: The float arithmetic requires combining the 13D/A percentages with the 20-F share count, and no aggregator does it: stockanalysis.com reports 10.86m shares outstanding and a US$37.45m market cap with no float adjustment at all. A stock where 41.3% is held by one person and baseline turnover is 4,600 ADSs a day cannot absorb even partial execution of a US$10m programme without gapping, so the downside from the four negative findings above is genuinely dampened relative to what the fundamentals alone would imply — which is why my net number is -9.5 and not the -11.5 the negatives sum to.
findings.independence: Share count from the FY2025 20-F cover: 'As of December 31, 2025, there were 542,229,838 ordinary shares outstanding' — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000119312526191472/yq-20251231.htm (2026-04-29). Market cap and 10.86m ADS from https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/yq/ (2026-09-08). Shares its source document with the 10b5-1 finding above and is the opposite-signed reading of it.
findings.shared_source_note: Same 13D/A as the 10b5-1 finding; net of the two is 0.0 on that document.

searched_and_found_nothing: Third-party app metrics for Yiqi Aixue / 一起爱学 — no Qimai, App Store or Android-store download or MAU series located, and the app is absent from the 36kr education-AI ranking of Feb 2026 (https://36kr.com/p/3681345039282048, dated 2026-02-13) and from the CNPP 2026 top-ten learning-app list; nothing trendable to test whether Q2 momentum held

Nasdaq listing compliance — no 6-K, no press release and no 20-F disclosure of any minimum bid price, minimum market value of publicly held shares, or ADS-ratio-change notice; the only ADS ratio change on record is the 2021 one
Equity financing / dilution risk — the EDGAR F-series browse endpoint returned HTTP 503 so this is unresolved rather than clean; no F-3, ATM or 424B appeared in any other filing list or search

Company guidance and sell-side estimates — YQ has never issued a revenue or EPS guidance range and I found no published analyst estimate, so there is no consensus to beat or miss and no 'whisper' to trade against
Government tender / procurement data for the To-G smart paper-pen business in Q2 2026 — no award notices found despite the AI-general-education procurement policy coverage of 2026-08-09
Hiring signal — no accessible careers page job-posting count or team-level change found for 17zuoye / 一起教育科技
Customer, supplier, distributor or competitor read-through — no China K-12 hardware or edtech peer gave post-June-2026 commentary that references this company

Item 16E of the FY2025 20-F (the mandatory issuer-repurchase table) — the document is too large for the fetch tool to reach that section, so 2025-programme execution is inferred from the persistence of the tag rather than measured
baseline_tension: There is no option chain and therefore no skew and no implied move to agree or disagree with, so the only statement of what is priced is the +42.5% 20-day and roughly +76% six-session run-up — and every one of my four negative findings cuts directly against it, because I can name the three documents that produced the run-up (a recycled buyback authorisation, automated 10b5-1 Form 4s, a boilerplate 13D/A) and none contains new economics; my one positive finding, the tiny float and the live bid, is the reason I am at -9.5 rather than lower, and the honest caveat is that with no chain I am less certain than usual about what has already been discounted.
